components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 15px; padding: 15px 25px; border: 1px solid #c5a059; background: rgba(197, 160, 89, 0.05); color: #fff; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #c5a059; color: #000; outline: none; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 20px 40px; background: rgba(3,3,4,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: 'Syncopate', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 30px; } .ds-nav-links a { position: relative; color: #989898; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; text-decoration: none; transition: 0.3s; } .ds-nav-links a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -5px; left: 0; width: 0; height: 1px; background: #c5a059; transition: 0.3s; } .ds-nav-links a:hover, .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible { color: #c5a059; outline: none; } .ds-nav-links a:hover::after, .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-links a.ds-nav-gold { color: #c5a059; }

narrative.overview: A black-hole void with a slow gold particle field. Content sits on dark, square, hairline-bordered panels and is written plainly. The cinematic world lives in the material and the motion, not in sci-fi labels. The signature is a gold line that draws down the side rail as you scroll and ends by underlining the email address in Contact.
keyCharacteristics: Void-black canvas, gold particle field, edge vignette
Syncopate for display and titles, Space Mono for everything else
Gold = action and identity; cyan = knowledge; green = Matrix easter egg only
Square hairline panels with a thin top accent rule
Coloured glow only on hover; flat at rest
One signature motion: the gold line

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Gold is action and identity, cyan is knowledge. Never swap them.

rules.name: The Void Base Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are the void plus a dark translucent fill; never a lighter solid grey.

rules.name: The Telemetry Rule
rules.body: If it is not a name or a title, it is in Space Mono.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small labels above headings; context goes beside or below the title.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No grey drop shadows. Depth comes from borders and colour on hover.

dos: Do keep surfaces as the void plus a dark translucent fill.
Do keep corners square; 2-4px only on tiny badges.
Do use gold for action and identity, cyan for knowledge (the One Job Rule).
Do use the physics ease (cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1)) for hover movement and the header.
Do put context beside or below a title, never above it.
Do use the :root tokens and the type ramp for every new colour and size.
donts: Don't use grey drop shadows or static glows.
Don't use Matrix Green outside the easter egg.
Don't put kicker or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't add backdrop blur to panels over the particle canvas.
Don't add a second signature motion; the gold line is the one.
